Hi Sarah — thanks for the note. We're happy to run a compact intake but want to be pragmatic about the pen-test vendor's needs. Options that have worked well in the past:

- Single 2.5–3 hour block: controls handoff (60–75 min) + pen vendor handshake and network scoping (90 min). Good when vendor needs on-call time to confirm access.
- Split approach: 45–60 min SOC2/DPA controls handoff + separate 60–90 min pen vendor kickoff on a different day. Minimizes engineer context switching.

I've attached a short agenda and our SOC2 evidence checklist for BlueRow so you can see what we typically ask for. If you prefer specific times on Feb 15–17, share them and we'll coordinate with SecureLabs.
